mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate level (FEDFUNDS below 1.0%) consistently predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as lower discount rates boost equity valuations.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 1.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI index exceeds 240 (CPIAUCSL > 240), indicating elevated inflation, the market anticipates aggressive monetary easing, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 240), or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A joint decline in FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL above 240 signals an accommodative monetary policy response to high inflation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary policy easing during high inflation
failure_condition: The interaction effect is absent: when FEDFUNDS declines and CPIAUCSL > 240, S&P 500 60-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) compared to baseline.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), the Federal Reserve implements aggressive rate cuts, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Positive nonfarm payroll growth (PAYEMS rising) consistently correlates with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as stronger labor markets support consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances with PAYEMS growth, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1200 thousand units (HOUST > 1200), it signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of triggered instances (HOUST > 1200), or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over 3-year periods.

mechanism_narrative: Joint growth in housing starts (HOUST > 1200) and retail sales (RSAFS > 450000) indicates broad-based consumer demand, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect is absent: when HOUST > 1200 and RSAFS > 450000, S&P 500 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) compared to baseline.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle slowdowns (INDPRO 3-month change < 0.0%), industrial production contraction signals economic deceleration, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO 3mo change < 0.0%, or the Rank IC is below -0.02 over 2-year windows.
